title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is a paper signal. No real orders are placed anywhere in the record. A single trade, win or lose, says nothing about a strategy, because the record is small and the outcomes are noisy. The notes below report the live paper record exactly as it stands, with no projection and no claim that any pattern will continue.

## What is open

The only open trade named in the record is a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026. It has been open since that date. The live snapshot also shows 0 positions open on paper for htf-rsi-v007, 0 for trend-daily-v005, and 0 for trend-daily-v006. Both statements are part of the same posted record and are reported here as posted. No additional trade details are available in the record beyond those figures.

## What has closed

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. This is one realized outcome in a paper record, not a verdict on the rule that produced it.

htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average of -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average of -13.34% net per trade. These averages describe the trades already closed; they do not describe trades that have not happened yet.

In testing, about two trades in three lost and the average winner was roughly +19%. Against that background, a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. This is a statement about the tested distribution, not a promise about the live record.

## What the market filter is allowing

trend-daily-v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026. trend-daily-v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. In the snapshot, the Bitcoin market filter is off for both engines. Both also show 0 positions open on paper. The two trend-daily engines also report the same three names closest to a 20-day breakout: UNIUSDT is 8.40% below its high, BNBUSDT is 9.00% below its high, and TRXUSDT is 9.82% below its high. These distances are measurements from the posted snapshot, not signals to act on.

## Where the record stands and where to check

The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-10T08:51:56.050Z. The record updates continuously, so the figures above are a snapshot rather than a final statement. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Because every entry here is paper, the results are unproven and inconclusive. They document what happened in the paper record; they do not establish what will happen next.
